verdict.rationale: The only evidence of an in-product assistant is a single mention of "Canva AI", where users paste links from other platforms to design with more context. That implies a built-in AI design assistant but says nothing about what tasks it can take on. The MCP server material (natural-language design generation and editing) is about external AI assistants connecting to Canva, so it is not a built-in assistant and is not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the built-in Canva AI's capabilities, evidence of multi-step task delegation inside the editor, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
